contract: pilot-v1 G1 draft 2, docs/plans/fintech-structural-pilot.md section "G1 contract"

conventions.candidate_owner_paths: paths relative to the provision root; node_id = <provision_id>#pilot-v1:<sha12>:<path>
conventions.decision: branch: the stage or branch that decides the row (V invalid_locator, S stale_projection, N scope or layout, R root locator, L0-L7 the G1.7 path-walk table, for the last step). also_applies: other branches whose conditions also hold for that step and lose by order.
conventions.locator: the request is {provision_id, locator, mode}; a row with "request" gives the raw request instead
conventions.modes: label, intro, complete; complete is the default. The key "request" means the raw request given in the row, whatever its mode.
conventions.node_id path: prefix: stands for the full node_id built from the path
conventions.span: half-open Unicode scalar offsets [start, end) into the exact text
conventions.synthetic_provision_id: provision ID used for a synthetic text in responses.json and projection-example.json

holdout: No holdout provision or answer was read. Compatibility with the sealed answers is for an independent evaluator to check privately after the contract is frozen.
method: Spans typed by hand from a paragraph table (start, end, text or opening characters) of each development provision and of each synthetic text. A script added substring hashes, quotes, node-ID prefixes and the JSON layout, and checked the hand-typed label quotes; no scanner, recognizer or probe produced any expectation.
